{{Youmayd|the occupation|Gladiator|[[Gladiator (disambiguation)]]}}
[[File:Scarred_Gladiator_FDCR.png|thumb|right|250px|A battle-scarred female gladiator]]

A '''gladiator''' was a person who fought&mdash;sometimes to the death&mdash;for money, or was made to fight against his, or her, will. The latter being condemned prisoners and [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] in particular. There were many forms of gladiator battles all over the galaxy, notably on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] and [[Rattatak/Legends|Rattatak]]. Some droids were built for the purpose of gladiator fights, such as the [[Mark X Executioner droid/Legends|Mark X Executioner]] or [[Bugnaught]]. [[Loovria/Legends|Loovria]] was also known for its gladiator pits.<ref name="The Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

The [[Regional Sector Number Four's All-Human Free-For-All]] was a gladiator event on [[Jubilar/Legends|Jubilar]].

The [[Viis Empire]] trained its [[Aaroun]] slaves as gladiators.<ref name="The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
